purpose: Additive per-site simulation quantities for eligible sites missing a reserve-map entry. Does not replace observed records or the 250-record reserve authority.
notes: Every value in records is simulation-only gameplay data, not verified geology or real-world output.
Canonical resource units are applied at runtime by omega_resource_quantity_normalization_v1.js.
Existing reserve rows take precedence. The runtime only uses these records to fill missing site IDs.
